rule: Measured depth below ground, each mandal scaled between its own 2nd and 98th percentile so a byte is worth the precision that mandal deserves. depth = minM + byte / levels * rangeM.
clipRule: Readings outside the 2nd to 98th percentile sit on the edge of the scale, so one freak month cannot flatten a decade.
caveat: Mandal-mean readings, not a single well, and not an official hydrograph.
